PROTO = "5a5a5a5a" * 8
CASES = [  # name, cell, arm, r, cert-degree, form, extra
    ("c1_eqs4_m3n06_D3_dual", "m3n06", "EQS4", 0, 3, "dual", []),
    ("c2_eqs4_m3n06_D3_primal", "m3n06", "EQS4", 0, 3, "primal", []),
    ("c3_eqs2_m3n06_D2_dual", "m3n06", "EQS2", 1, 2, "dual", ["--always-ann"]),
    ("c4_eqs4_m3n07_D3_primal", "m3n07", "EQS4", 0, 3, "primal", []),
    ("c5_nullprof_m3n06_D4_dual", "m3n06", "NULL-PROF", 0, 4, "dual", ["--always-ann"]),

    ("c7_eqs4_m3n05_D2_dual", "m3n05", "EQS4", 1, 2, "dual", []),
]
def rd_gz(p): return [json.loads(l) for l in gzip.open(p, "rt").read().splitlines() if l.strip()]
rng = HashRng(777, "tamper")
manifest = []
for name, cell, arm, r, D, form, extra in CASES:
    d = os.path.join(OUT, name); os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    rundir = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=OUT, prefix="_run_")
    args = RUN.parse(["--run-dir", rundir, "--cell", cell, "--arm", arm, "--r", str(r), "--protocol-sha256", PROTO,
                      "--no-isolate", "--cert-degree", str(D), "--ann-form", form, "--wdag", "never", *extra])
    st = RUN.run_trial(args); assert st["status"] == "completed", st.get("traceback")
    key = f"{cell}/{arm}/r{r}"
    clos = rd_gz(os.path.join(rundir, "closures.jsonl.gz"))
    cert = [c for c in clos if c.get("kind") == "certificate" and c["cert_kind"] == "ann"]
    if not cert or cert[0]["M8"]["status"] != "pending_checker":
        print("no cert for", name, cert); shutil.rmtree(rundir); shutil.rmtree(d); continue
    m8 = cert[0]["M8"]
    inst = [i for i in rd_gz(os.path.join(rundir, "instances.jsonl.gz")) if i["key"] == key][0]
    shutil.copy(os.path.join(rundir, inst["system_file"]["path"]), os.path.join(d, "system.sys.json.gz"))
    shutil.copy(os.path.join(rundir, m8["path"]), os.path.join(d, "cert.ann.json.gz"))
    json.dump(inst, open(os.path.join(d, "instance_record.json"), "w"), indent=1, sort_keys=True)
    rec = [c for c in clos if c.get("D") == D and c.get("key") == key and "M1" in c][0]
    json.dump({k: rec[k] for k in ("M1", "M2", "M5", "D", "status")}, open(os.path.join(d, "closure_record_subset.json"), "w"), indent=1)
    sysb = gzip.decompress(open(os.path.join(d, "system.sys.json.gz"), "rb").read())
    cj = json.loads(gzip.decompress(open(os.path.join(d, "cert.ann.json.gz"), "rb").read()))
    assert cj["form"] == form, (cj["form"], form)
    prod = RC.check_ann(cj, sysb)
    def write_variant(fname, c):
        data = certs.cert_bytes(c)
        with gzip.GzipFile(os.path.join(d, fname), "wb", mtime=0) as g: g.write(data)
        import hashlib
        return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    key_f = "L_hex" if form == "dual" else "basis_hex"
    vec = [int(h, 16) for h in cj[key_f]]
    ncols = sum(1 for _ in range(0))  # unused
    # constant-monomial column = last column index C-1; C = number of monomials of degree <= D
    from math import comb
    C = sum(comb(cj["nv"], k) for k in range(D + 1))
    def flipped(i, c):
        v = list(vec); v[i] ^= 1 << c
        c2 = dict(cj); c2[key_f] = [format(x, "x") for x in v]; return c2
    t1 = flipped(0, C - 1)
    i2, c2_ = rng.randbelow(len(vec)), rng.randbelow(C)
    t2 = flipped(i2, c2_)
    variants = []
    for fn, tc, desc in (("tamper_declared.ann.json.gz", t1, f"declared tamper: bit of the constant-monomial column (column {C-1}) of the first {key_f} entry"),
                         ("tamper_random_flip.ann.json.gz", t2, f"random single-bit flip: entry {i2}, column {c2_}")):
        sha = write_variant(fn, tc)
        variants.append({"cert_file": fn, "description": desc, "cert_sha256": sha, "expected_verdict": "reject-or-equivalent",
                         "producer_reference_checker_accept": RC.check_ann(tc, sysb)["accept"]})
    man = {"case": name, "instance_key": key, "arm": arm, "cell": cell, "r": r, "protocol_sha256_dummy": PROTO,
           "system_file": "system.sys.json.gz", "instance_record": "instance_record.json",
           "cert_file": "cert.ann.json.gz", "cert_sha256": m8["cert_sha256"], "D": D, "form": form, "expected_verdict": "accept",
           "M1_at_D": rec["M1"], "system_sha256": inst["system_sha256"], "raw_system_sha256": inst["raw_system_sha256"],
           "producer_reference_checker_accept": prod["accept"], "tampered_variants": variants,
           "note": "producer-side sample; D is the closure degree of the claim (non-containment at D, not at 4, for D<4)"}
    json.dump(man, open(os.path.join(d, "README.json"), "w"), indent=1, sort_keys=True)
    manifest.append({"dir": d, "files": sorted(os.listdir(d))})
    shutil.rmtree(rundir)
json.dump(manifest, open(os.path.join(OUT, "MANIFEST.json"), "w"), indent=1)
for m in manifest: print(m["dir"], m["files"])
